grid.layout_notes: Sheet lists 6x3 branding; base starts at 243 ways on a ways grid that can expand up to 6 symbols high via xWays (up to 46,656 ways in bonus). Riot Respin / free spins unlock a 6th reel.

win_system.notes: Starts at 243 win ways; may expand up to 46,656 ways during bonus features. Riot Respin unlocks 6th reel for at least 729 ways. Civil War starts on minimum 729 ways.

respins.how_it_works: Riot Respin: triggered by 2 scatters; locked Molotov Wilds; unlocks 6th reel for at least 729 win ways.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: xWays mystery symbol holds 2–4 symbols and expands reels up to 6 high (punk characters may super-expand up to 20 high). In free spins xWays always expand to 4 high. 6th reel unlocks in Riot Respin and Anarchy/Civil War free spins.

other.name: Molotov Wilds
other.how_it_works: Wilds substitute for any symbol except scatter; expand upwards on the reels.

other.name: Jumping Wilds (bonus)
other.how_it_works: In Anarchy/Civil War free spins, scatters become Jumping Wilds; may be enhanced by subway train above the reel set.

wilds.name: Molotov Wild
wilds.behavior: Substitutes for any symbol except scatter; expands upwards. Locked during Riot Respin.

wilds.name: Jumping Wild
wilds.behavior: During Anarchy (3 scatters) and Civil War (4 scatters) free spins, scatters become Jumping Wilds for the bonus round.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 2 scatters → Riot Respin. 3 scatters → 8 Anarchy Freespins. 4 scatters → 8 Civil War Freespins.

specials.name: xWays Mystery Symbol
specials.behavior: Holds 2–4 symbols; expands reels up to 6 high. Punk characters may super-expand up to 20 symbols high. In free spins xWays always expand to 4 high.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on a ways grid starting at 243 ways. xWays may expand reel heights; Molotov Wilds expand upward. 2 scatters trigger Riot Respin (locked Molotovs + 6th reel). 3 scatters award 8 Anarchy Freespins; 4 scatters award 8 Civil War Freespins. Optional Nolimit Bonus buy into free spins.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop. xWays mystery symbols expand (2–4 high, characters up to 20). Molotov Wilds may expand upward.

phases.name: Evaluate ways wins
phases.what_happens: Pay left-to-right ways wins on the resulting grid (base 243 ways).

phases.name: Feature check
phases.what_happens: 2 scatters → Riot Respin with locked Molotov Wilds and unlocked 6th reel (≥729 ways). 3 scatters → Anarchy FS. 4 scatters → Civil War FS.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways wins after xWays/Molotov expansions; Riot Respin and free spins re-evaluate on expanded reel sets.
base_game_loop.notes: Sheet math block shows Total RTP 96.01% while intro quotes 96.11%/94.18% dual setup — both preserved in rtp_notes.

modes.name: Riot Respin
modes.trigger: Two scatters in the main game.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Molotov Wilds locked; 6th reel unlocked for at least 729 win ways.

phases.name: Lock & unlock
phases.what_happens: Lock Molotov Wilds; unlock 6th reel (≥729 ways); play the respin.

modes.effects: Explosive respin with locked Molotov Wilds and unlocked 6th reel (≥729 ways).

modes.name: Anarchy Freespins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: 6th reel unlocked for the bonus; scatters become Jumping Wilds throughout.

phases.name: Enter Anarchy
phases.what_happens: Unlock 6th reel; convert scatters to Jumping Wilds for the round; subway train above may enhance Wilds.

phases.name: Play 8 spins
phases.what_happens: xWays always expand to 4 high in free spins.

modes.effects: 8 FS on unlocked 6th reel; Jumping Wilds from scatters; xWays expand to 4 high.

modes.name: Civil War Freespins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Minimum 729 win ways; all 4 scatters become Jumping Wilds.

phases.name: Enter Civil War
phases.what_happens: 8 spins on ≥729 ways; 4 scatters become Jumping Wilds.

modes.effects: 8 FS; ≥729 ways; four Jumping Wilds from the triggering scatters.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Retrigger/extra-spin rules during Anarchy/Civil War not stated on sheet. CMS buy blurb mentioning Buffalo Horde is cross-game paste — ignored.

features.name: xWays Mystery Symbol
features.effects: Holds 2–4 symbols; expands up to 6 high (characters up to 20). Always 4 high in free spins.

features.name: Molotov Wilds
features.effects: Substitute except scatter; expand upwards; locked during Riot Respin.

features.name: Riot Respin
features.effects: Respin with locked Molotovs and unlocked 6th reel (≥729 ways).

features.name: Nolimit Bonus (Feature Buy)
features.effects: Buy the two Freespins versions (Anarchy / Civil War). May be removed in some regulated markets.

options.name: Nolimit Bonus — Anarchy / Civil War
options.effects: Buy either of the two free-spins versions.

feature_buy.notes: Buy costs not listed on Punk Rocker sheet.

numeric_limits.max_win_notes: 15,072× bet (sheet math). Some secondary sources quote 15,000×.
numeric_limits.rtp_notes: Sheet math Total RTP 96.01% (DX1 94.10% / DX3 90.16%). Intro also states dual setup 96.11% and 94.18% (DX1). Main 42.84%, Riot Respin 20.11%, Freespins 33.06%.
numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 21.38%; freespin 1 in 244; win 100× 1 in 789.

## xWays® Mystery Symbol
A mystery symbol that holds 2 to 4 symbols that expands the reels, up to 6 symbols high. Punk characters may be super-expanded up to 20 symbols high, for massive wins!\nxWays® always expand to 4 high in Freespins.

## Molotov Wilds
Wilds that substitutes for any symbol except the scatter, that expands upwards on the reels for massive hits.

## Riot Respin
The main game feature, that triggers on two scatters, which allows for an explosive respin with locked Molotov Wilds and a 6th reel that is unlocked for at least 729 win ways.

## Anarchy Freespins
Bring on the mayhem with an unlocked 6th reel over the course of 8 Anarchy Freespins triggered by 3 scatters. The Freespins all scatters becomes Jumping Wild throughout the bonus round, where the Wilds may be enhanced by the subway train above the ordinary reel set.

## Civil War Freespins
Chaos deluxe! 8 Civil War Freespins - triggered by 4 scatters - on a minimum of 729 win ways where all 4 scatters becomes Jumping Wilds. Experience Big Win after Big win....

## Nolimit Bonus - Feature Buy functionality
Nolimit Bonus - allows the players to buy directly into\nthe Freespin. Choose to buy Buffalo Horde and Prair
